name.value: Holiday Park Four Season RV & Condo Resort

description.value: A large four-season RV-and-condo resort community between Kelowna and Vernon with resort-level amenities including a restaurant, pool, and 24/7 security; the Okanagan Rail Trail runs directly alongside the property, making it a convenient corridor stop for touring cyclists, though accommodation is primarily RV sites and condos rather than tent pitches.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sweetlife.com is confirmed as Holiday Park Resort at 1-415 Commonwealth Road, Lake Country, matching the OSM record. The office phone (250-766-4255) matches OSM, but the website footer email (holiday@holidaypark.ca) differs from the OSM email (holiday@sweetlife.com). The website explicitly states the Okanagan Rail Trail runs directly alongside the resort, and confirms an on-site licensed restaurant, convenience store with bike rentals, and TripAdvisor reviews embedded on the site corroborate the presence of showers.
concerns: OSM email (holiday@sweetlife.com) differs from website footer email (holiday@holidaypark.ca); the website value is likely current.

OSM name includes 'Four Season' but the website consistently refers to the property as 'Holiday Park Resort' or 'Holiday Park RV & Condo Resort' without 'Four Season'; may be an outdated or informal name variant.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A large, established year-round RV resort with direct Okanagan Rail Trail access, on-site food, and bike rentals — a strong fit for touring cyclists in the Kelowna-Vernon corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The local area page notes EV charging stations 'in Kelowna' — this appears to reference off-site community infrastructure, not resort amenities, and was not counted toward e-bike charging.

wow_evidence: Okanagan Rail Trail runs directly alongside the resort
